profile.name: 串口通信接口组件
profile.description: 用于实验控制软件的非物理串口通信组件，提供命令/数据串口的连接、写入、关闭和通信日志记录功能，常用于通过 SCPI 与仪器进行通信和调试。
profile.description_en: A non-physical serial communication component used in laboratory control software. It provides command/data serial port connection, writing, closing, and communication log functions, and is commonly used for SCPI-based instrument communication and debugging.

registry.description: Abstract base class from which the data and command interfaces are derived
